lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid arrangement consisting of approximately 5 to 6 visible horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots, extending from the posterior pectoral region toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal lines of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern where blobs serve as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the mid-to-upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity highlights on the superior edge to low-intensity shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A moderate density of small, high-luminance blobs is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, appearing less systematically organized than the lateral flank grid.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal fish (remoras) are visible in a clustered formation near the ventral-posterior margin of the pectoral fin and lower lateral flank.
